name: Glory Of God The
overview: The Glory of God is revealed as a profound and majestic attribute that Moses earnestly desired to behold, yet was told no one can see God's face and live. In Exodus 33, God promises to pass His glory by Moses, covering him for protection while allowing him to see His back, symbolizing both the holiness and the inscrutable majesty of God. This passage highlights God's sovereign goodness, mercy, and the reverence due to His holy presence, underscoring the greatness and eternal nature of His glory as foundational to understanding His power and character.
